snippet.title: My Friend Dysentery - Announcement Trailer | A Horribly Realistic Fantasy Travel Simulator
snippet.description:
A Horribly Realistic Fantasy Travel Simulator.

Wishlist My Friend, Dysentery on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4716680/My_Friend_Dysentery/

Learn more:
https://mfdgame.com/

Join the Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/kBdtPFnK5n

======================================

My Friend Dysentery is a retro party-based adventure RPG roguelike & darkly comedic fantasy reimagining of the classic Oregon Trail, where you lead a ragtag party of adventurers across the magically cursed wilderness known as The Great Wyld. Build your party, manage their needs, survive the journey, and try to make it to Faerland in one piece. Your quest? To kill a Dragon that dwells there and save your wizard friend from turning to stone!

Your party is made up of unique characters with different fantasy races, classes, stats, and personality quirks. Along the way, you will face everything from party arguments and mysterious encounters to disease, starvation, monsters, and turn-based battles against creatures straight out of classic fantasy.

The journey will be dangerous. Your party will suffer. Monsters will rip you to shreds.
 
Despite all this...

Dysentery will probably kill you first.

FEATURES
• Create a unique party of fantasy adventurers
• Explore a procedurally generated wilderness
• Manage health, morale, hunger, warmth, hygiene, and sanity
• Make difficult decisions & choices on the road
• Experience unpredictable events and encounters
• Battle more than 100 monsters in brutal turn-based combat
• Fight dragons and other legendary creatures
• Discover your own stories and disasters along the way
• Get lost in The Wyld and ask your wizard friend for help
• Die horribly, learn from it, and try again
